title: QH 207/32 ↔ QH 207/38 X-ray / archive gate
source_basis: Fitzenreiter, Willer, Auenmüller 2016, QH 207 catalogue and imaging chapters
University of Bonn current Elmar Edel-Archiv description

xray_core_finding.QH_207_38: The radiograph demonstrates that only the foot/lower-foot regions of individual Osiris statuettes are bronze-filled; the upper portions were not bronze casts in the preserved state. The 2016 catalogue identifies four wax Osiris figures modelled directly onto existing bronze foot fragments.
xray_core_finding.radiograph_card_note: Aufnahme erfolgte, bevor die abgefallenen Teile angeklebt waren.
xray_core_finding.interpretation_boundary: The card note and object documentation strengthen a probable QH 207/32 ↔ QH 207/38 association, but do not by themselves prove original physical continuity without the original images/geometry and custody documentation.

QH_207_32.fundbook: Osiris statuette from a casting mould; modelling material with copper/bronze foot, foot glued by A.E.
QH_207_32.association: The bronze foot is considered highly probably identical with the foot shown for QH 207/38; Bonn archive list notes one of the four figures was missing and should be compared with QH 207/32.

QH_207_38.fundbook: Casting mould for four Osiris statuettes; statuettes in modelling material, feet and pins beneath feet in bronze; unburnt Nile mud.
QH_207_38.radiograph_result: Only the feet/lower regions of individual Osiris figures are bronze-filled.
QH_207_38.documentation_limit: No all-around photographic documentation; only two sides were photographed.

date_discrepancy.2016_volume: states the radiographs were made in 1971 by Werner Maslankovski at Rheinisches/LVR-LandesMuseum Bonn

required_inputs: all original radiographs / negatives of QH 207/38, all exposures and orientations
radiograph index card and exposure/inventory metadata
highest-resolution original 1969 object photographs of QH 207/32 and QH 207/38
original drawings and fundbook / casting-form-list entries
transfer / loan / partition / storage / custody records for QH 207/32 and QH 207/38
killer_gate.pass_condition: Recover source-bound geometry or archival continuity sufficient to test whether the QH 207/32 bronze-foot/wax figure is the missing fourth figure from QH 207/38.
killer_gate.promotion_rule: Expert agreement alone is REVIEW_FEEDBACK; physical/documentary continuity is required for promotion.

outreach.subject: Archival request — QH 207/32 and QH 207/38 original radiographs, object photographs and custody records
